description: Generate React forms from JSON Schema: $ref, allOf/oneOf/anyOf, if/then/else, dependencies, custom widgets, zero dependencies.
rules: Import SchemaForm from 'react-simple-schema-form'; styles are optional via 'react-simple-schema-form/styles.css'.
Widget precedence: uiSchema prop (exact, then globs) > parent's nested uiSchema keyword > inline ui:widget > resolveWidget prop > built-in default.
Inside an if condition, always include required: [key] alongside properties.key.const, otherwise a missing key satisfies the condition.
Custom widgets call onChange(undefined) for empty and must forward required, disabled, onBlur and spread options.props.
